# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_FADE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After an opening range breakout, the first retest to VWAP often fails due to diminishing participation, offering a fade opportunity. This edge exists because initial breakout momentum exhausts liquidity, causing the VWAP retest to lack follow-through and reverse.

## Mechanism

**Entry:**  
- Define opening range (OR) as high/low of first 30-minute bars (09:30-10:00 ET).  
- If price breaks OR high by ≥0.1% (long breakout) OR OR low by ≥0.1% (short breakout).  
- Within next 15 minutes (by 10:15 ET), if price retraces to touch session VWAP.  
- Enter fade opposite breakout direction (short for up breakout, long for down breakout) ONLY if volume on retest bar < 70% of average volume of breakout bar(s).  

**Exit:**  
- Initial stop at opposite OR side (above OR high for short fade, below OR low for long fade).  
- Target at 1.5R or trailing stop of 10% ATR.  
- Avoid trades during major news (FOMC/CPI) and when OR width <0.2%.  
- Regime filter: VIX <20 and first 90 minutes of trade (09:30-11:00 ET).
